items.text:
Oh my God it's so frustrating just how awful this game is because it could really be something special. Put in about 53 hours since 1.0 in the last few days, and for the most part I thought things had really improved significantly since I played in late 2024, but it's just not worth the frustrations. This should not have been released, and I refuse to believe the developer doesn't know that. So why? Running out of funds and need to push it out to get another round of suckers?

Authority/Pirate ships will randomly try to dock with you which is fine and adds some excitement. However what is NOT fine is that they blast towards you at ridiculous speeds and dock with you while travelling >100 m/s which obliterates both of your ships. I had to reload a save 10 times trying to maintain a relative velocity with the authority ship below 100 m/s just so they could dock with me. One of those times I managed to do it and the NPC just stood on their bridge for 5 minutes doing nothing. So, I requested undocking permission, which was granted, but after trying to release clamps they walked up to me at my navigation terminal and identified me as a criminal. Reload again, and again, and eventually able to show them my license and go about my business.

AI crew is still absolutely and despicably abhorrent. Hygiene low? Better brush my teeth. Oh - oops I'm wearing an EVA suite in a vacuum, silly me I'll go back to work. Oh hygiene is still low, let me walk back to the same spot that I just failed to brush my teeth at and try again. Nope still in an EVA suit in a vacuum. Well, back on the ship with perfect atmosphere I'll try brushing my teeth. Damn! I am still wearing a helmet, guess I'll suffer. 

Comfortable bunk in the ship, accessible and available. Crew will be standing NEXT TO the bunk and decide to walk to the air lock (which is pulled to a vacuum) without a helmet and sleep on the floor. Perfectly fine when controlling the crew and forcing them to use the bed.

Otherwise all psychological and physiological needs were met with this crew member after manually intervening - until I decided to have the captain sleep, and fast-forward 6 hours. Suddenly they were just having a miserable existence and wanted to quit. Well, they got locked in the airlock and the turbo pumps suddenly and mysteriously turned on and slowly suffocated, so at least there was a good ending.

Eventually flying to Venus with torch drive, trash AI pirate attempts to intercept me - probably a coffin or something. Can't catch me, but after a couple hours and having gone from 100m/s - >100km/s relative to OKLG they are still chasing me. How can they have that much N2 (IR sensor shows no reactor)? Given up on this save as I know that once I reach drift phase they will eventually catch up, travelling at some insane speed and just slam into me anyway.

Restored He-3 tank while in transit, also one of the pellet feeders. He-3 went from 2000Kg to full and after that no longer losing any fuel despite reactor running at full flow and still burning. Great time.

Loaded up that save after a day and hit with mortgage for my ship as it was 00:00 on 9/1. What's this? Also a mortgage for 00:00 8/1? That's before the start date on the damn game. 

Just save yourself the pain and frustration and steer clear.
items.text_zh:
哦我的天哪，这游戏烂得让人太沮丧了，因为它本来真的可以很特别。自1.0以来，这几天我玩了大约53个小时，大部分时候我觉得自从2024年末玩过之后，情况确实有了显著改善，但那些挫败感还是不值得。这游戏本不该被发布，我拒绝相信开发者不知道这一点。那为什么呢？资金耗尽了，需要把它推出去再骗一轮冤大头？

权威/海盗船会随机尝试与你对接，这没问题，还增添了一些刺激感。然而没问题是——它们以荒谬的速度朝你冲过来，并在以超过100米/秒的速度航行时与你对接，这会摧毁你们双方的飞船。我不得不重新读档10次，试图与权威船保持低于100米/秒的相对速度，好让它们能与我对接。其中一次我成功做到了，结果那个NPC就站在他们的舰桥上5分钟什么也不做。于是，我请求解除对接许可，获得了批准，但在尝试释放锁扣之后，他们走到我所在的导航终端前，把我认定为罪犯。再次读档，一次又一次，最终才得以向他们出示我的执照，继续做我的事。

AI船员依然绝对且可鄙地令人憎恶。卫生度低？最好去刷牙。哦——糟糕，我在真空中穿着EVA服，我真傻，我回去工作吧。哦卫生度还是低，让我走回刚才刷牙失败的那个地方再试一次。不行，还是在真空中穿着EVA服。好吧，回到大气完美的飞船上，我来试着刷牙。该死！我还是戴着头盔，那就忍着吧。

飞船上有一张舒适的双层床，可到达且可用。船员会站在双层床旁边，然后决定不戴头盔走到气闸（已被抽成真空）并睡在地板上。当控制船员并强迫他们使用床时，一切完全正常。

除此之外，在手动干预之后，这名船员的心理和生理需求都得到了满足——直到我决定让船长睡觉，并快进6个小时。突然间他们就过着悲惨的生活，想要辞职。好吧，他们被锁在气闸里，涡轮泵突然而神秘地启动了，他们慢慢窒息而死，所以至少有个好结局。

最终用火炬驱动器飞往金星，垃圾AI海盗试图拦截我——大概是个棺材之类的东西。追不上我，但几个小时后，相对于OKLG从100米/秒变成了>100公里/秒，他们还在追我。他们怎么会有那么多N2（红外传感器显示没有反应堆）？放弃这个存档了，因为我知道一旦我进入漂移阶段，他们最终会追上来，以某种疯狂的速度飞行，然后照样撞上我。

在运输途中恢复了He-3储罐，还有一个燃料丸供给器。He-3从2000公斤变成了满罐，之后尽管反应堆全流量运行并仍在燃烧，却不再消耗任何燃料。真是好时光。

一天后加载那个存档，因为到了9月1日00:00，就收到了我飞船的抵押贷款。这是什么？还有8月1日00:00的抵押贷款？那是在这该死的游戏开始日期之前。

还是省省你的痛苦和挫败吧，离它远点。

observations.description: 存档加载后出现日期错误的抵押贷款，包括游戏开始日期之前的贷款

items.text:
This a perfect simulator of dystopian spaceship salvager. You are a slave to the corporation, and every story out there is your own: when you undock from the station and go to scrap your first derelict freighter or your hundredths, anything can happen or nothing can happen and every adventure is your own. The game is very addicting and not hand holdy. You are left to your own devices, and you can solve many problems by thinking outside the square. I highly recommend this hidden gem for anyone that wants a challenging and rewarding experience. When you come home after work and fire this one up you will feel a great deal of satisfaction when you cobble together your own ships from bits of space junk and weld it together with a bit of spit and good luck and go off on a lightyear adventure to explore the unknown. Maybe go mine asteroids, maybe go fight spare pirates. Anything is possible. It’s your own path out there, go and explore. 10/10

Edit: the game is full of bugs, quest system doesn't work that well and optimisations is bad, game lags a lot when performing multiple tasks. These are small thins, what the game lacks in quality in makes up tenfold in gameplay. But yes, negative reviews have valid points.
items.text_zh:
这是一个完美的反乌托邦飞船打捞模拟器。你是公司的奴隶，而那里的每一个故事都是你自己的：当你从空间站解缆出发，去拆解你的第一艘废弃货船，或者你的第一百艘时，任何事情都可能发生，也可能什么都不发生，每一次冒险都是你自己的。这游戏非常上瘾，而且不手把手教你。你被放任自流，你可以通过跳出框框思考来解决许多问题。我强烈推荐这个隐藏的宝石给任何想要挑战性和有回报体验的人。当你下班回家后启动这款游戏，当你用太空垃圾碎片拼凑出自己的飞船，用一点唾沫和好运把它焊接在一起，然后出发去进行一场光年冒险探索未知时，你会感到极大的满足。也许去开采小行星，也许去和零散的太空海盗战斗。一切皆有可能。那是你自己的道路，去探索吧。10/10

编辑：游戏充满了bug，任务系统运作得不太好，优化也很差，执行多项任务时游戏会严重卡顿。这些都是小事，游戏在质量上的欠缺在玩法上弥补了十倍。但没错，负面评论有合理的观点。

observations.evidence: quest system doesn't work that well
observations.evidence_zh: 任务系统运行得不太好

items.text:
Its a tragedy this game is being released at 1.0 shortly. It needs a LOT more time to cook. The ideas are so phenomenal but the execution is just not there as things are. Basic functions in the game don't work reliably. AI is broken to the point where its easier and safer to just manually do everything instead of giving orders. Either that or get ready to reload the save because your auto-tasked character walked out into the vacuum of space without putting on their helmet, while you're in the middle of a salvage. Okay so full manual control it is. Except the art direction and UI make every moment a fight to do what you need to. The missions are bugged and randomly disappear. The performance is awful, even on a beefy computer. None of these would be deal breakers but apparently the game is being released as 'feature complete' in days. There is no way all the major issues are addressed in a few days when it hasn't happened over the years this has been in EA. 

It pains me to be so critical because there is currently nothing out there trying to do what this game is. Underneath all the issues is my dream space sim- one where you can pilot your own ship (complete with tactile switches and knobs), build and tinker with various parts, trade, fight, and basically just RP living in the Firefly universe.
items.text_zh:
这个游戏即将在1.0版本发布，真是个悲剧。它需要更多时间来打磨。想法非常出色，但就目前的情况来看，执行根本不到位。游戏中的基本功能无法可靠运行。AI坏到了极点，以至于手动做所有事情比下达命令更容易也更安全。要么就准备好重新加载存档，因为你自动分配任务的角色没戴头盔就走进了太空真空，而你正在打捞中途。好吧，那就完全手动控制吧。但美术方向和UI让每一刻都变成了一场为实现目标而进行的战斗。任务有bug并且会随机消失。性能很糟糕，即使在性能强劲的电脑上也是如此。这些都不是致命问题，但显然游戏几天后就要以“功能完整”的状态发布了。多年来在EA阶段都没能解决的问题，不可能在几天内全部解决。

如此苛刻地批评让我很痛苦，因为目前没有任何游戏在尝试做这个游戏所做的事情。在所有问题之下，是我梦想中的太空模拟游戏——一个你可以驾驶自己的飞船（配有触觉开关和旋钮），建造和修补各种部件，贸易，战斗，基本上就是在《萤火虫》宇宙中角色扮演生活。

items.text:
Can't recommend after the developer made it clear they don't care about the abundant bugs. They've essentially put out a barely playable beta version that manages to dazzle with a seemingly promising outlook and a great soundtrack. And to be clear, this could be a great game if they ever got beyond the basics.

This outlook got corrected with the dev stating that after six years of part-time development, they don't have any plans to go beyond 1% of the initially promised content of a living solar system. This happened right after they managed to get an infamous "indie-riffic" publisher (meaning "never the big time") with more bug-ridden shovelware games on board. The devs are not above deleting critical threads on the forum, and reporting and banning players for imagined infractions either.

It's not just the game breaking bugs that have been discussed many times on the forum without response from the devs. I had to use the debug console multiple times just to keep my save going, not to cheat in any way. It's also a line of baffling design decisions about the clunky UI producing endless amounts of inventory tetris and other annoyances. NPC AI is broken beyond belief even in the "1.0" version. Even save game management is broken in ways that should never have been released to the public.

The basic gameplay loop features almost zero actual tactical decisions, instead it's 95% waiting for timers to run down. Timers to uninstall parts, timers to repair them. Then return to the space station to sell everything and watch the game break in front of your eyes. Hoarding and selling like the most basic 90s dungeon crawler but surprise: there is no actual dungeon. Even the fights are a poor excuse for what could have been. Most quests simply break along the way and cannot be completed.

Another failed early access title, and the part-time amateur developers who put two types of marihuana cigarettes into their game don't even understand how to work constructively with the community for modding and content creation.
items.text_zh:
在开发者明确表示他们不在乎大量bug之后，无法推荐。他们基本上发布了一个勉强能玩的测试版，靠着看似有前途的前景和出色的配乐让人眼花缭乱。而且要说清楚，如果他们能超越基础层面，这本来可能是一款很棒的游戏。

这种前景在开发者声明之后被纠正了：经过六年的兼职开发，他们没有任何计划去实现最初承诺的活太阳系的1%内容。这发生在他刚刚找到一个臭名昭著的“独立范儿”发行商（意思是“永远成不了大气候”）之后，该发行商旗下还有更多满是bug的劣质游戏。开发者也不是不会删除论坛上的批评帖子，还会因为想象出来的违规行为举报和封禁玩家。

不只是那些在论坛上被讨论过很多次却得不到开发者回应的破坏游戏的bug。我不得不多次使用调试控制台只是为了让我存档能继续下去，完全不是为了作弊。还有一系列关于笨拙UI的令人费解的设计决策，产生了无穷无尽的库存俄罗斯方块和其他烦人之处。NPC AI即使在“1.0”版本中也破碎得令人难以置信。甚至存档管理也以绝不应该公开发布的方式坏掉了。

基本玩法循环几乎没有任何实际的战术决策，相反，95%的时间都是在等待计时器走完。卸载零件的计时器，修理零件的计时器。然后回到空间站卖掉一切，看着游戏在你眼前崩溃。像最基础的90年代地牢爬行游戏那样囤积和出售，但惊喜来了：根本没有真正的地牢。就连战斗也是对本来可以做成什么样的一种糟糕借口。大多数任务在途中就直接坏掉，无法完成。

又一个失败的抢先体验作品，而那些把两种大麻香烟放进游戏里的兼职业余开发者，甚至都不懂如何与社区建设性地合作进行模组制作和内容创作。

items.text:
I am giving this game a positive review, because I really enjoyed my time with it (for the most part, see below), and if the features that aren't in it yet make it into the final game, it will be epic. 

**HOWEVER**

If you are on the fence at all about buying it now or waiting, I recommend waiting. 

 The actual content that is currently in the game was well worth the price to me. I really enjoyed flying around and salvaging. I found a nice big freighter with barely any damage or anything missing and patched it up. Then I began collecting parts and laying out plans for remodelling the interior to make it exactly how I wanted it. I was really loving this game.

I could overlook it's jankiness, because of the fun I was having otherwise.  Sometimes I would attempt to put objects on the floor of my ship and they'd vanish completely. I lost an entire crate full of equipment to this bug. Sometimes my character would get stuck and I'd have to reload a save, losing an hour of gameplay. A salvaged door wouldn't fit on the floor, so I couldn't put it down, but then it wouldn't go back into my inventory either so every time I opened the inventory I'd have this door in my hand again and couldn't do anything else. Reload a save, lose progress. 

As I said, I could live with all that. Save more often, shrug it off.  However, the early access jank chose a new form just now and it broke my enthusiasm.  I am 18 hours in, and still had my original starting character. Just now I was playing and the game bugged out again. I opened a context menu for a door or something, but it wouldn't let me select anything. Frozen again, no huge deal. I saved and exited to menu. Tried to continue from the save, which has always worked before. Nope. Get an error screen saying program has to restart. Close it, try again. No dice, same message.

There is only one save file, so when it inevitably gets corrupted, that game is done. It's infuriating.

18 hours down the drain. I don't have the patience or the desire to start over from scratch, especially knowing it will just happen again. So I'm going to wait until this game is much further along in development before playing it again. I know it is Early Access and bugs are the norm. I can deal with nuisances, but completely losing my save is where I draw the line.

So, if you think the game looks like fun, you will probably have fun with it. What is there was worth the price, when it worked. If, however, losing all your progress after many hours of play will piss you off (as it did me), then you'd be better off waiting until the game is much further along.


**Update-4/14/20***

I got over the anger at losing my save and started over. Played 10 more hours and enjoyed my time in the game. I'm still going to recommend waiting a bit for bug fixes if you feel like that will aggravate you.  There's also not a ton of content, aside from the basic loop of flying around and salvaging, and fixing up your ship. 10 hours into my new game and I'm rich beyond my ability to spend it. There are a few more things I've yet to try, but not much.

Still, I enjoyed it for 28 hours so far, and do not regret the purchase.
items.text_zh:
我给这款游戏一个好评，因为我真的很享受玩它的时光（大部分时候是这样，详见下文），而且如果那些尚未加入的功能能进入最终版本，它将会非常史诗。

**然而**

如果你对现在买还是再等等有任何犹豫，我建议再等等。

目前游戏中的实际内容对我来说完全值这个价。我真的很喜欢四处飞行和打捞。我找到了一艘又大又好的货船，几乎没有任何损坏或缺失的东西，然后把它修好了。接着我开始收集零件，并规划内部改造方案，想把它弄成我理想中的样子。我当时真的很喜欢这款游戏。

我可以忽略它的粗糙，因为除此之外我玩得很开心。有时候我会尝试把物品放在飞船的地板上，它们就会完全消失。我因为这个bug损失了整整一箱装备。有时候我的角色会卡住，我不得不重新加载存档，损失一个小时的游戏进度。一扇打捞来的门放不进地板，所以我没法把它放下，但它也回不到我的物品栏里，所以每次我打开物品栏，这扇门就又出现在我手里，我什么别的都做不了。重新加载存档，进度丢失。

就像我说的，这些我都能忍。多存档，耸耸肩就过去了。然而，抢先体验版的粗糙刚刚换了一种新形式，击垮了我的热情。我已经玩了18个小时，用的还是最初创建的角色。刚才我在玩的时候，游戏又出bug了。我打开了一个门或什么东西的上下文菜单，但它不让我选择任何东西。又卡住了，本来不算什么大事。我保存并退出到菜单。尝试从存档继续，这以前一直都能用。不行。出现一个错误屏幕，说程序必须重启。关掉，再试。没用，同样的提示。

只有一个存档文件，所以当它不可避免地损坏时，这个游戏就完了。这让人极其愤怒。

18个小时付诸东流。我没有耐心也没有意愿从头再来，尤其是知道这种事还会再次发生。所以我打算等到这款游戏开发得更加完善之后再玩。我知道这是抢先体验，bug是常态。我可以应付各种烦人的小问题，但完全丢失存档是我的底线。

所以，如果你觉得这游戏看起来好玩，你大概会玩得开心。在它能正常运行的时候，现有的内容值这个价。但是，如果你在玩了很多小时后丢失所有进度会让你火冒三丈（就像我一样），那你最好等到游戏开发得更加完善再说。


**更新-2020年4月14日***

我从丢失存档的愤怒中缓了过来，重新开始。又玩了10个小时，很享受在游戏里的时光。如果你觉得那些问题会让你恼火，我仍然建议再等一段时间，等bug修复。除了四处飞行、打捞和修飞船这个基本循环之外，内容也不算多。新游戏玩了10个小时，我富得钱都花不完。还有几样东西我还没试过，但也不多了。

不过，到目前为止我享受了28个小时，并不后悔购买。

items.text:
[b]Edit Note:[/b] I have decided to rewrite my review to better explain whats going on with this game, as I feel that when I first gave it a thumbs up and then changed it to a thumbs down I had two waves of passion. When I first started up the game it was excitement and hope, then that changed into frustration and disappointment the longer I played. This review is going to be a bit long winded, so if you have a short attention span, don't bother reading. But i don't think you would be interested in this game if you did.

Buying this game now would be based on how you would define Early Access and on how much you would be willing to put up with. The reason i changed my rating to a thumbs down is because this is the first EA game that I've played, and I've played more then my fare share of EA's, that has been so unplayable. There are several bugs that stop you from continuing any progress in the game, which as people are quick to say but its EA! once again it is in how you define EA that determines what you expect because EA has no defining term and a person can only judge based on past experience. Mine has been relatively good in that regard and i have not been disappointed in any other EA game that i have played. But all of the other EA games that i have played released in a stable enough form that you could play the game. Would they have bugs that yes sometimes crashed the game? or had weird glitches and graphical malfunctions? Of course! And they also didn't have all their intended features, which is what i think is the primary reason for doing EA. Having time and getting funding for working out the minor bugs and adding new features that the developers intend for the game.

This game has all of those EA risks, but this game also has a lot more going wrong with it. Which is why i feel that it is a bit too early for this game to be released into EA and why i changed my rating to a thumbs down. Its to give warning for others who are considering this game but would not enjoy going through all the issues that are currently above and beyond what i would consider to be normal for a EA title. 

What I consider....that is my main point. Others will feel differently than me, but if you are still reading this that means you are like me and read mostly negative reviews to find out if this game is worth your time and money.

Honestly i feel like it will be. The Dev is reading the forums and looking at the bug reporting and trying to fix them as quickly as possible. The bug that killed the game for me was a bug that had your character walking in place and unable to do anything at all. That was the bug that stopped all progress in the game for me and i could do nothing else but try and restart the game. It would fix it for a few moments, but as i started doing tasks to repair a ship i was working on, it would happen again. 

When all progress stops at the same point you are longer able to find other issues that may be wrong with the game. So the Dev seems to have made that a top priority for fixing, he just released a patch to fix that issue, but that has also cause some worse issues to turn their ugly heads. And that is fine, I am willing to put up with it. The real question is, are you? And Ill explain why i am willing to put up with it.

For some reason the idea and concept of this game really draws me in, i am constantly looking for the updates to fix the issues that are stopping me from playing so i can go back and play some more. The character backstory customization choices are really a cool idea that gives and bit of a more random element to how your character is. It allows you to kinda roleplay your game play experience in a very cool way. That's why i feel more disappointment when the game comes to the point of not being able to play and i end up losing all of my progress. But the whole idea of running around as a low level shipbreaker trying to get that first ship you dock with fixed so that you can move on and try to go and salvage whole ships apart and get that money to hire some crew, but you have to talk and build relationships with NPCs before hiring them and you can do some customization on the layout of your own ship with things you salvages is just great.

To end, the bugs are bad. Really bad. But the concept of the game and the Developer himself seem good. And you will only find these types of games from indie developers. You will never get this anywhere else, so buy it and wait if you dont want to deal with the bugs at this moment, but want to give some sort of help to the developers. Or just wait, wishlist it, and come back to check on it. Or if you really want to be apart of the no foundation yet type of EA game, just the hole dug. Get it and play it and be active on the forums. This is the most active ive been on any game forum and probably the longest review ive ever written. Its a special game. But i dont want anyone to be fooled by sweet words and misleading gameplay footage. Im a realist on the state of this game and the future of this game. So heed what i have said and make up your own mind.

Lastly i have left open comments for constructive arguments as to why other people would agree or disagree with me. No Trolling, we are all damn adults here. Thanks.
items.text_zh:
[b]编辑说明：[/b] 我决定重写我的评测，以更好地解释这款游戏到底是怎么回事，因为我觉得当我最初给它点赞，然后又改成点踩时，我经历了两波情绪。当我第一次启动游戏时，那是兴奋和希望，但随着我玩得越久，这变成了沮丧和失望。这篇评测会有点啰嗦，所以如果你注意力不集中，就别费心读了。但如果你真是那样，我想你也不会对这款游戏感兴趣。

现在购买这款游戏，取决于你如何定义抢先体验，以及你愿意忍受多少。我把评分改成点踩的原因，是因为这是我玩过的第一款如此无法游玩的EA游戏，而我玩过的EA游戏可远不止我应得的那一份。有几个bug会阻止你在游戏中继续任何进度，人们会很快说但这是EA啊！再一次，这取决于你如何定义EA，这决定了你的期望，因为EA没有明确的定义，一个人只能根据过去的经验来判断。在这方面我的经历相对不错，我玩过的任何其他EA游戏都没有让我失望。但我玩过的所有其他EA游戏发布时都足够稳定，你可以玩下去。它们会有bug吗？是的，有时会让游戏崩溃？或者有奇怪的故障和图形问题？当然有！而且它们也没有所有预期的功能，我认为这正是进行EA的主要原因。有时间和获得资金来解决小bug，并添加开发者打算为游戏加入的新功能。

这款游戏有所有这些EA风险，但这款游戏还有更多出问题的地方。这就是为什么我觉得这款游戏发布到EA还太早，也是为什么我把评分改成点踩。这是为了给其他正在考虑这款游戏、但不会喜欢经历目前所有这些问题的人一个警告，这些问题超出了我认为EA游戏正常应有的范围。

我所认为的……那是我的主要观点。别人会和我感觉不同，但如果你还在读这个，那意味着你和我一样，主要读负面评测来判断这款游戏是否值得你花时间和金钱。

老实说，我觉得它会值得。开发者正在阅读论坛，查看bug报告，并试图尽快修复它们。让我玩不下去的那个bug，是让你的角色原地行走，完全无法做任何事。那个bug阻止了我在游戏中的所有进度，我除了尝试重启游戏之外什么也做不了。它会修复一小会儿，但当我开始做任务修理我正在处理的一艘船时，它又会发生。

当所有进度都在同一点停止时，你就不再能够发现游戏中可能存在的其他问题。所以开发者似乎把修复那个问题当成了首要任务，他刚发布了一个补丁来修复那个问题，但这也导致一些更糟糕的问题露出了丑陋的面目。这没关系，我愿意忍受。真正的问题是，你愿意吗？我会解释为什么我愿意忍受。

不知为何，这款游戏的想法和概念真的很吸引我，我不断寻找更新来修复那些阻止我游玩的问题，这样我就能回去再玩一些。角色背景故事的自定义选择真的是一个很酷的想法，给你的角色带来了一点更随机的元素。它让你能以非常酷的方式在游戏体验中进行某种角色扮演。这就是为什么当游戏到了无法游玩的地步、我最终失去所有进度时，我会感到更加失望。但作为一个低级拆船工四处奔波，试图修好你对接的第一艘船，以便你能继续前进，尝试去把整艘船拆解回收，赚到钱来雇佣一些船员，但你必须先和NPC交谈并建立关系才能雇佣他们，而且你可以用回收来的东西对自己的飞船布局做一些自定义，这整个想法就是很棒。

最后，bug很糟糕。真的非常糟糕。但游戏的概念和开发者本人似乎都不错。你只会从独立开发者那里找到这类游戏。你在别的地方永远得不到这个，所以如果你现在不想应付bug，但又想给开发者某种帮助，就买下它然后等待。或者就等着，把它加入愿望单，然后回来看看。或者如果你真的想成为那种还没有基础、只是挖了个坑的EA游戏的一部分，就买下它，玩它，并在论坛上活跃。这是我在任何游戏论坛上最活跃的一次，可能也是我写过的最长的评测。这是一款特别的游戏。但我不想让任何人被甜言蜜语和误导性的游戏画面所欺骗。对于这款游戏的现状和未来，我是个现实主义者。所以注意我说的话，然后自己做出决定。

最后，我开放了评论，供大家提出建设性的论点，说明为什么别人会同意或不同意我。禁止钓鱼引战，我们在这里都是该死的成年人。谢谢。
角色背景故事自定义选项真是个很酷的主意，它给你的角色带来了一点更随机的元素。它让你能以非常酷的方式对自己的游戏体验进行某种角色扮演。这就是为什么当游戏到了无法游玩的地步、我最终失去所有进度时，我感到更加失望。但作为一个低级别的拆船工四处奔波，努力把你对接的第一艘船修好，好让你能继续前进，去尝试把整艘船拆解回收，赚到钱来雇佣一些船员，但你必须先和NPC交谈并建立关系才能雇佣他们，而且你还可以用你回收来的东西对自己飞船的布局做一些自定义——这整个想法简直太棒了。

最后，bug很糟糕。真的非常糟糕。但游戏的概念和开发者本人看起来都不错。而且你只能在独立开发者那里找到这类游戏。你在别的地方永远找不到这样的东西，所以如果你此刻不想应付这些bug，但想给开发者某种帮助，那就买下它然后等待。或者干脆就等着，把它加入愿望单，然后再回来看看。或者如果你真的想参与这种还没有地基、只挖了个坑的EA游戏，那就买下来玩，并在论坛上保持活跃。这是我在任何游戏论坛上最活跃的一次，大概也是我写过的最长的评测。这是一款特别的游戏。但我不想让任何人被甜言蜜语和误导性的实机画面所欺骗。对于这款游戏的现状和未来，我是个现实主义者。所以请留意我说的话，然后自己做出决定。

最后，我开放了评论，欢迎就其他人为什么会同意或不同意我进行建设性的辩论。禁止钓鱼引战，我们在这里都是该死的成年人。谢谢。
